notes: Product-specific primary stations for documented JMA public latest CSV products.
Does not authorize Weather features for production use by itself.
Must not be applied retrospectively to historical final observations.

requirements: station period open (to=null) for live mapping
required element AVAILABLE in candidate available_elements
station_id present in documented public CSV for the product family
quality column present in product CSV

precipitation.semantic: PUBLIC latest precipitation products (1/3/6/12/24h). Not a continuous 10-min private feed; update ~10 min per official note (~30 min after observation for precip page).

temperature_extreme.semantic: PUBLIC daily high/low temperature extreme tables. NOT race-time instantaneous temperature.

wind_max.semantic: PUBLIC daily maximum wind speed tables (with direction at max). NOT continuous 10-min instantaneous wind.

gust_max.semantic: PUBLIC daily maximum wind gust tables. NOT continuous gust series at race time.
